verdict.rationale: Clerky lets attorneys be set as a reviewer or observer on everything clients do, or be added only when needed. Users can also loop in an attorney to review and comment, and every change is logged. This gives a basic review step on document sets, but nothing shows configurable, multi-step approval routing that gates signature, and the product centers on startup formation and equity paperwork rather than general contracts. Missing for 10: configurable approval workflow rules (sequential or conditional approvers), an explicit approval gate before signature, support for arbitrary contracts beyond startup templates, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
